title: Great for a child's plate, not an adult
text: Great for a child's plate, not an adult. Plates are kind of flimsy but considering price...it's a good buy. Better suited for younger children with light appetites.

product_metadata.title: Unique Colorful Santa Dinnerware Party Bundle | Dinner & Dessert Plates, Large Napkins, Activity Placemats | Paper Disposable Kids Christmas Holiday Dessert Dinner Set
features: SANTA HOLIDAY DESIGN - This Christmas themed tableware is printed with cheery images of Santa in his sleigh above colorful winter scenes. Perfect for kids at home and school.
CHRISTMAS EVENTS - This bundle is perfect for holiday gatherings, family dinner, winter celebrations, classroom parties, and more. The perfect disposable paper set for the kids table!
DURABLE PLATES - Includes 8 dessert plates (7") and 8 dinner plates (9"). They are made from premium quality material, making them durable and sturdy.

SOFT NAPKINS & COLORING PLACEMATS - Includes 16 luncheon napkins sized 6.5". Made from high quality paper material, these napkins are soft and absorbent. Also includes 8 paper placemats with activities and coloring to keep kids busy at your holiday meal.
EASY TO DISPOSE OF - Every item in this bundle is conveniently disposable for quick and easy cleanup!
